definitions.explanation: A seat that is available on a first-come, first-served basis without prior reservation.

examples.japanese: {自由席|じゆうせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦{勝|が}ち→勝ち：02540_kachi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.notes: {早|はや}い{者|もの}{勝|が}ち is a set phrase: "first come, first served."

examples.japanese: {自由席|じゆうせき}⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦なし→なし：03779_nashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{乗|の}れる→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: With unreserved seats, you can ride without a reservation.

examples.japanese: {自由席|じゆうせき}⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいた→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The unreserved seat car was crowded.

examples.japanese: {自由席|じゆうせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Unreserved seats are cheaper than reserved seats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧{自由席|じゆうせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{座|すわ}れる→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: If you take an early morning train, I think you can get a seat even in the unreserved cars.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧ (free, unrestricted) + ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (seat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自由席|じゆうせき} - unreserved seat (cheaper, but no guaranteed seat)
- ⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧ - reserved seat (a guaranteed seat, for an extra fee)
- ⟦グリーン{車|しゃ}→グリーン車：08489_guriinsha⟧ - Green Car (the first-class car; all seats reserved)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自由席|じゆうせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧ - to sit in an unreserved seat
- {自由席|じゆうせき}⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧ - unreserved-seat car
- {自由席|じゆうせき}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ - unreserved-seat ticket

TRAIN CONTEXT:
On the Shinkansen, the unreserved cars are usually at one end of the train. At busy times passengers in them may have to stand for the whole journey.

COST:
{自由席|じゆうせき} is cheaper than {指定席|していせき} because no {指定席|していせき}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (reserved-seat fee) is charged on top of the base fare.
